name: Story Clock
author: dsh-tavern
description: Tracks in-fiction time in the chat variable `clock` (minutes since day 1, 08:00). Exposes {{clock}} macros, the /clock STscript command family (show / advance / set), an AgentTavern prompt section, a post-save observer, a user-input cleanup transform, periodic timers and an optional LLM-backed turn summarizer (requires the llm capability).
